Equivalent for an insert-only index. The double-rotation branch only runs after the outer test found the left subtree more than one taller than the right. If height(left.right) == height(left.left), the insertion that triggered the imbalance cannot have been on the left: before the insert both grandchildren already had that height, so left.height was unchanged and the outer test would have been false. Equality is therefore unreachable on the only mutation path ResourceIndex exposes (insert; invalidate only clears a profile). A temporary differential probe over all 720 insertion orders of keys 1..=6 produced identical heights and tree shapes under both operators.
